_comment: Org policy overrides. Demotions and ignores appear in every result under policy_applied and are written to the audit tab, so a relaxed rule stays visible.

_rationale.missing_disclaimer_financial: Admin directive 2026-08-24: challenger creatives are not required to carry a disclaimer. RSOC and linkout units route to an advertiser destination rather than making the offer themselves, so an issuer-style disclaimer does not apply. Requirement dropped, not merely downgraded.
_rationale.missing_disclaimer_figure: Same directive. A stated dollar amount no longer implies a disclaimer requirement on the creative.
